== Biography ==
Martin Sundelin was born in Sweden on November 11, 2000. He grew up in Sweden, holds dual Swedish and Peruvian citizenship, and has a mother who is from Peru.

== Trivia ==
* Part of a select group of players called "Royal Roaders", earned after winning their rookie split in a major region (LEC Winter 2023)
* Has a 100% winrate in LEC finals he has played.<ref>[https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896294368958644332 Sheep Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* After his win of the LEC ([[LEC/2025 Season/Winter Playoffs|LEC 2025 Winter]]) with [[Karmine Corp]], he became the third player alongside [[Targamas]] to win the LEC in two different teams, after [[Caps]] and [[Hylissang]]<ref>https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896368788301631590</ref>

=== Individual Awards ===
* x1 LEC Rookie of the Year (2023)
* x3 LEC 1st All Pro Team (Summer 2023, Winter 2024, Spring 2025)
* x1 LEC 2nd All Pro Team (Winter 2023)
* x1 LEC 3rd All Pro Team (Spring 2023)
